## 5. Owner counting by city (repository)

Counting is NOT a dedicated repository method — it is done in-memory in `Cities`:

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Cities.java`
```java
final class Cities {
    private Cities() {}
    /** The number of existing owners in the given city. */
    static long countIn(OwnerRepository ownerRepository, String city) {
        return ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
                .filter(existing -> city.equals(existing.getCity()))
                .count();
    }
}
```
Note: this counts ALL owners (it does NOT filter out soft-deleted owners, unlike `AssignOwnerNamesakeCount` which filters `!existing.isDeleted()`).

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java` — the interface. It has NO `countByCity`/`findByCity` method; only `findAll()`, `findByLastName`, `findByTelephone`, `findByEmail`, `findById`, `save`, `delete`. So `Cities.countIn` relies on `findAll()`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's personal title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned as given, and used to compose the 'salutation'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and always returned. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed form: the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street types expanded) and echoed back.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), a hyphen, and the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year (fiscal year starting 1 July, e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's identity key: the 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined by '|'. Two owners collide on this key only when they share a telephone, an email and a phonetically-equal surname, so it is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '3b1c...'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate

## Summary

I implemented the `capacityWarning` flag following the existing `bulkSignupWarning` precedent exactly, keeping each concern in its own small unit and reusing the code that already counts a city's owners.

**What changed:**

1. **`AssignOwnerCapacityWarning.java`** (new) — a single-responsibility step that sets the flag when the city already holds 40–49 owners. It reuses `Cities.countIn(...)` (the same count set the hard rejection uses, so warning and rejection can never disagree) and references `EnsureCityUnderCapacity.CAPACITY` as the single source of truth for the limit of 50. The upper bound `< CAPACITY` means the flag is only about *approaching* — the hard 409 rejection at 50 is untouched.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `assignCapacityWarning` into the assign chain right after `assignBulkSignupWarning`, with `govern: [ transaction ]` like its neighbours. Placed after `build` and before `save`, so the count excludes the owner being created (it isn't persisted yet) — matching the "already has" semantics.

3. **`Owner.java`** — added the persisted `capacityWarning` boolean with `isCapacityWarning()`/`setCapacityWarning(...)`, capturing the warning at creation time (so a later `GET` returns the value as observed then, consistent with `bulkSignupWarning`).

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `capacityWarning` read-only boolean to the Owner schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct maps it by name automatically.

5. **DB schemas** (hsqldb, postgres, h2, mysql) — added the `capacity_warning BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` column to match the non-null entity field.

The acceptance test `coreWarnsWhenApproachingCapacity` (fill a city to 40, next owner warns) passes, as does the full suite.
